in_marathi.name: Mrinalika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Jewel of the mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mrinalika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mrinalika is derived from the Sanskrit words 'mrina' which means 'jewel' and 'alika' which means 'mind'. In Hindu mythology, Mrinalika is the name of a goddess who is the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge. She is often depicted holding a lotus flower and is believed to bestow the blessings of knowledge, intelligence, and understanding.
